verdict.headline: This result is indistinguishable from the best of a large number of coin flips.
reasons: The search ran 3,456 trials, which lifts the bar a winner has to clear from a Sharpe of 0 to a Sharpe of 0.46.
The observed Sharpe of 0.07 deflates to a 3% probability that the true Sharpe is above that bar.
Across every symmetric split of the sample, the in-sample winner finished below the out-of-sample median 61% of the time. One half is what pure chance looks like.
